integration-support-001.subject: How do I create and manage email accounts?
integration-support-001.body: Please explain how to create and manage email accounts.
integration-support-001.original_draft:
Based on the Brilliant Directories documentation for **Emails » Email Accounts**:

## Emails » Email Accounts Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558363 Email accounts (mailboxes) at the website's own domain, such as support@example.com , are created and managed in Settings > Domain Manager > Mailboxes . The Emails > Email Accounts menu item opens that tab directly. ## Before starting - Connect a custom domain to the website. A free directoryup.com address has no mailboxes of its own. - Confirm which provider receives the domain's email. Mailboxes on the website's hosting receive new mail only when the domain's MX records point to them. ## Open the email accounts - In the admin, open Emails . - Click Email Accounts . - Domain Manager opens on the Mailboxes tab, which lists the mailboxes, their storage use, and where the domain's email is delivered. Email Accounts in the Emails menu (1) opens Domain Manager on the Mailboxes tab (2). ## Create and manage mailboxes On the Mailboxes tab, Add a mailbox creates a new mailbox with its password and storage limit. Each mailbox in the list offers Open webmail , Set up for the settings to enter in Outlook, Apple Mail, or a phone, and More for changing the password or storage limit or deleting the mailbox. The full steps are in Settings » Domain Manager » Mailboxes and Email Routing . Generic addresses such as info@ are more often treated as spam by receiving mail systems. Addresses such as support@ , admin@ , or contact@ are usually a better choice. ## When the previous Email Accounts page appears The previous Manage Email Accounts page still opens in two cases: - The website uses a free directoryup.com address. The page explains that a live domain name must be connected before email accounts can be set up, and offers Connect Live Domain . See How to Connect a Domain to a Brilliant Directories Website . - The administrator's role does not include access to the Domain Manager's Mailboxes tab. On a free directoryup.com address, Email Accounts shows the previous page with Connect Live Domain (1). ## Additional notes - Email replies do not have a separate reply-to address. Responses go to the address that sent the original message. - To read a mailbox in the browser, see How To Access Webmail Through the Admin Area .

**Helpful Screenshot(s):**
- [View UI Screenshot 1](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186415572/original/0_RFHNGWzxRNTrt3i385M8zCmScYPSCYpg.png?1791392588)
- [View UI Screenshot 2](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186358595/original/8ZBIk7xdczVdG2JjzsZeChbSSdKHPbks4Q.png?1791318600)

**Source:** [Emails » Email Accounts](https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558363-emails-email-accounts) (Category: Emails > Email Accounts)

ui_4b7450b231.original_draft:
Based on the Brilliant Directories documentation for **How To Add An ads.txt File**:

## How To Add An ads.txt File Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000040190 ## What is an ads.txt file? The use of ads.txt files is an initiative from the Interactive Advertising Bureau Tech Lab (IAB) to improve transparency in advertising. This initiative has been adopted by many of the large advertisement platforms, including Google Adsense. Installing an ads.txt file is as simple as uploading a file named ads.txt to the root of the website containing information provided by the banner / advertisement platform of choice (EG: Google Adsense). For more detailed information about the ads.txt specification, please see this page on the IAB website: https://iabtechlab.com/ads-txt/ ## How to add an ads.txt file - Navigate to Settings » Design Settings » Banner Ads » - Enter Ads.txt content : Add the required ads.txt content for this field and please allow up to 24 hours for Google and other networks to reflect this change. Once the update has been propagated the content will now be accessible at http://www.YourDomain.com/ads.txt

ui_4dee6661ee.subject: equest for a refund
ui_4dee6661ee.body: Hello, I am unhappy with the service and want a full refund immediately. Please confirm that you will refund me today.
ui_4dee6661ee.original_draft:
Based on the Brilliant Directories documentation for **How to Cancel a Brilliant Directories Subscription**:

Closes the cancellation flow and keeps the subscription active. - I Still Want to Cancel: Continues to the cancellation confirmation screen. ### Choose When the Cancellation Takes Effect The Cancel Subscription window allows the account owner to choose when the cancellation should take effect. The available cancellation options are: - At the end of the billing cycle: The website stays online until the listed billing date. No future charges are made after the paid billing cycle ends. - Immediately: The website goes offline immediately. Email and all connections stop working immediately. The selected option controls when the cancellation takes effect. ### What Happens When a Subscription Is Canceled The Cancel Subscription window explains what happens when a website subscription is canceled. - The subscription is marked Cancelled and the website will be suspended. - All add-ons and extra resources are canceled alongside the subscription. - After 30 days of suspension, the website is archived for long-term backup storage. - The website subscription can be reactivated within the 30-day window. Review these details carefully before confirming the cancellation request. ### Confirm the Cancellation The cancellation form requires a reason for cancellation and a typed confirmation before the final cancellation button becomes available. - Select when the cancellation should take effect. - Review the details in the What cancellation does section. - Enter the reason for cancellation in the available field. - Type CANCEL in the confirmation field. - Click the final cancellation button. The final confirmation button may show: - Cancel at End of Cycle - Cancel Now The subscription is not canceled until the final cancellation button is clicked. Click Keep Subscription to exit the cancellation flow and keep the subscription active. ## Billing History Tab The Billing History tab displays invoices connected to the account. Invoice records can include: - Invoice date - Description - Website name and Site ID - Status - Amount - View invoice option - Download invoice option ## Search and Filter Billing History The Billing History tab includes tools to search and filter invoice records. Available billing history filters include: - Search invoices: Search billing records by invoice-related details. - All Sites: Filter invoices by website. - All Status: Filter invoices by invoice status. The website filter can be used to view invoices for all websites or a specific website connected to the account. The status filter can include: - All Status - Paid - Past Due - Failed - Refunded ## View Invoice Details The eye icon opens the invoice details window for the selected invoice. - Go to the Billing History tab. - Locate the invoice that needs to be reviewed. - Click the eye icon on the right side of the invoice row. The Invoice Details window can include: - Invoice number - Due date - Description - Status - Payment method - Total due - Download option ## Download an Invoice Invoices can be downloaded from the Billing History tab or from the Invoice Details window. - Go to the Billing History tab. - Locate the invoice that needs to be downloaded. - Click the download icon on the right side of the invoice row. A PDF copy of the invoice will open or download depending on the browser settings.

knowledge.query:
New Project Request
"Interested in your agency services. Can you build out a highly customized property marketplace directory for us?
knowledge.answer:
Based on the documentation provided, here is the information regarding building a customized property marketplace directory:

**1. Platform Capabilities for Customization**
The Brilliant Directories platform supports highly customized directory structures. You can leverage the **Marketplace** to obtain free quotes from certified developers for specific customizations, ranging from small changes to total theme makeovers. Additionally, you can book **Private Phone Training** to learn how to manage the directory and increase productivity.

**2. Membership Structure for a Property Marketplace**
You can structure your property marketplace using the recommended **3 Member Tiers** to maximize value and visibility:

*   **Basic Tier (Entry-Level):**
    *   Suitable for new users or free members.
    *   Features: Public directory listing with limited visibility, basic profile (logo, short bio, contact form), limited posting (e.g., 1 listing), and standard search placement (below paid members).
    *   *Property Context:* Ideal for individual agents or small listings with limited exposure needs.

*   **Premium Tier (Enhanced Visibility):**
    *   Suitable for professionals or small businesses.
    *   Features: Higher search placement, featured listing badge, SEO-friendly custom profile URL, full media uploads (images, video, social links), unlimited listings/events, instant leads, and custom profile layout/branding.
    *   *Property Context:* Ideal for real estate agencies or property managers who need to showcase multiple properties with rich media and generate leads.

*   **Elite Tier (Top Exposure):**
    *   Suitable for verified professionals or large organizations.
    *   Features: Top placement in all search results, Verified/Pro badge, featured placement on homepage/newsletters, unlimited content posting, priority/exclusive leads, analytics dashboard, ad-free profile, custom design, and ability to add team members under one account.
    *   *Property Context:* Ideal for major real estate firms or property developers requiring maximum visibility, team management, and detailed analytics.

**3. Geographic Search & Service Areas**
For a property marketplace, the **Service Areas / Multi-Location Add-on** is critical. It allows members to be found in locations outside their immediate physical address.
*   **How it works:** Members can select service areas at five levels: Countries, States/Provinces, Counties, Cities/Towns, and Zip Codes/Postcodes.
*   **Search Logic:**
    *   If a member selects a **smaller** area (e.g., a specific Zip Code), they appear in searches for that area and all larger areas containing it (e.g., City, County, State, Country).
    *   If a member selects a **larger** area (e.g., a State), they appear in searches for that state and **all** smaller locations within it (e.g., all cities, counties, and zip codes in that state).
*   **Radius Searches:** Service areas can also be treated using bounds and radius settings (e.g., appearing in results if within 50 miles of the searched location).

**4. Support & Resources**
*   **Knowledge Base:** Access detailed documentation on how the software works.
*   **Technical Support:** Submit a ticket for the fastest response or email support@brilliantdirectories.com.
*   **Developer Marketplace:** Hire certified developers for advanced customizations.

**Recommendation:**
To build your highly customized property marketplace, you should:
1.  Define your three membership tiers (Basic, Premium, Elite) with property-specific benefits (e.g., unlimited property listings for Premium/Elite).
2.  Implement the **Service Areas Add-on** to allow real estate agents and property managers to be found in multiple geographic locations.
3.  Use the **Marketplace** to hire certified developers for any unique custom features not covered by the standard platform.
4.  Utilize **Private Training** to ensure your team can effectively manage the directory.
